importPage.title: Import questions from CSV
importPage.intro: Upload many questions at once with the CSV template. Fill it in Excel, Google Sheets or LibreOffice.
importPage.step1: Download the template and fill one question per row. Remove the sample rows before uploading.
importPage.step2: Save as CSV (UTF-8). Comma and semicolon separators are both supported.
importPage.step3: Upload the file. Every row is checked first; if any row is wrong, nothing is saved.
importPage.maxRows: At most {{count}} questions per file, up to 2 MB.
importPage.errorsIntro: Fix these rows and upload again:

docs.type: choice (multiple choice) or true_false. Also accepts mc / tf.
docs.grades: Target grades separated by semicolons: TK;1;2 or a range such as 4-6.
docs.subject: math, science, language, social, english or civics.
docs.games: flag-quest and/or sky-quiz separated by semicolons. Empty = every matching game.
docs.options: option_1_id … option_6_id: answer options (at least 3 for multiple choice). _en columns are optional.
docs.answer: Multiple choice: number of the correct option (1–6) or letter A–F. True/false: true/false or benar/salah.
